title: benchmark.spec_ready (v1)
description: EvaluatorAgent has finished selecting/preparing a benchmark and frozen a BenchmarkSpec into the Research Store (see agents/evaluator_agent/data-contracts/benchmark_spec.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the spec is read from the Research Store by ref. EvaluatorAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M7) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

benchmark_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen BenchmarkSpec object.

benchmark_id.description: Stable identifier of the selected benchmark, mirroring BenchmarkSpec.benchmark_id.
